annotation.title_clean: Décision n° 2021-817 DC du 20 mai 2021 - Loi pour une sécurité globale préservant les libertés
annotation.title_en: Decision No. 2021-817 DC of 20 May 2021 - Law for Comprehensive Security Preserving Freedoms
annotation.summary_en: French Constitutional Council decision reviewing the Global Security law. It strikes down provisions on police drone surveillance (art. 47), vehicle-mounted cameras (art. 48), and other articles, as disproportionate to privacy rights, while upholding drone detection by private security agents (art. 36) and body cameras with reservations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Article 47 on police camera drones struck down as disproportionate infringement of privacy: broad purposes, no maximum duration or perimeter, no cap on drone numbers
Article 48 on vehicle-mounted cameras struck down for lacking limits and authorisation
Article 36 allowing private security agents to detect drones upheld; no delegation of police powers
Body cameras (art. 45) upheld subject to guaranteed integrity and traceability of recordings
Article 1 (municipal police judicial powers) and article 41 (custody video surveillance) held unconstitutional
